name: Side Profile to Talent
description: Transforms a side-profile reference into a clean frontal close-up, then expands the same identity into a consistent 2x2 talent grid.
author: SV75

data.prompt: create a full-color frontal portrait talent with no glasses, isolated on a pure white background and wearing a simple white tank top, framed tightly on the face and upper shoulders with a clean centered composition, neutral expression, direct eye-level camera angle, soft even studio lighting, natural skin texture, realistic proportions, minimal styling, no accessories, and an overall clear, neutral, professional reference-photo look

data.inputPrompt: create a full-color frontal portrait talent with no glasses, isolated on a pure white background and wearing a simple white tank top, framed tightly on the face and upper shoulders with a clean centered composition, neutral expression, direct eye-level camera angle, soft even studio lighting, natural skin texture, realistic proportions, minimal styling, no accessories, and an overall clear, neutral, professional reference-photo look

imageHistory.prompt: create the model without glasses and only the face on a white background with a white tank top, the photo must be a frontal portrait

data.prompt:
{
  "meta_data": {
    "project": "talent_turnaround_2x2",
    "version": "1.0",
    "style": "neutral",
    "purpose": "consistent face identity sheet"
  },
  "output_settings": {
    "format": "png",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
    "layout": "2x2 grid",
    "background": "plain light neutral"
  },
  "hard_constraints": {
    "preserve_identity": true,
    "same_person_in_all_panels": true,
    "consistent_age": true,
    "consistent_face_structure": true,
    "consistent_hair": true,
    "consistent_skin_tone": true,
    "no_beauty_filter": true,
    "no_face_modification": true
  },
  "creative_prompt": "Create a clean 2x2 portrait reference grid of the same @talent with consistent identity across all four panels. Show four angles: front view, strict 90-degree side profile, three-quarter view, and back view. Keep expression neutral, styling minimal, framing consistent, and lighting soft and even. Use a simple studio setup and neutral background. The result should feel objective, clear, and suitable as a facial reference sheet for any face.",
  "composition": {
    "framing": "head and shoulders",
    "camera_height": "eye level",
    "subject_position": "centered",
    "grid_order": [
      "front",
      "side_90",
      "three_quarter",
      "back"
    ]
  },
  "lighting_and_camera": {
    "lighting": "soft even studio light",
    "contrast": "low to medium",
    "lens_look": "neutral portrait",
    "distortion": "minimal"
  },
  "constraints": [
    "neutral expression",
    "consistent wardrobe",
    "consistent grooming",
    "no dramatic shadows",
    "no strong styling changes",
    "no accessories unless kept identical in all views"
  ],
  "negative_prompt": [
    "different person",
    "identity drift",
    "asymmetrical layout",
    "extreme expression",
    "cinematic lighting",
    "heavy retouching",
    "beauty edit",
    "fashion pose",
    "cropped head",
    "inconsistent hair",
    "different clothing between panels"
  ],
  "image_description": "Neutral identity-preserving 2x2 portrait turnaround sheet for a single talent.",
  "tags": [
    "talent sheet",
    "2x2 grid",
    "front view",
    "profile view",
    "three-quarter view",
    "back view",
    "neutral portrait",
    "identity preservation"
  ],
  "nbp_commands": {
    "generate": true,
    "variation": false,
    "masking": false,
    "color_grading": "neutral",
    "export": {
      "format": "png",
      "background": "solid"
    }
  }
}
